description: Golden fixture: input bundle -> expected chain-definition execution_hash. Reuses shipped per-kernel fixtures for step inputs; this file fixtures the chain composition, not the kernels.

output_payload.chain_description: CBPR+ structured-address linter (art-241) -> purpose-code requirement checker (art-243) -> LEI payment-binding linter (art-246) -> MT-MX translation fidelity scorer (art-245). PASS only when all four checks pass; FAIL surfaces the failing check(s).

steps.handoff: structured-address lint result feeds Stage 2 purpose-code check
purpose-code check result feeds Stage 3 LEI payment-binding lint
LEI payment-binding lint result feeds Stage 4 translation-fidelity scoring
translation-fidelity score composes with the prior three checks into the per-template PASS/FAIL ISO-migration preflight receipt. Terminal stage.
